name: @mohasinac/dsa
description: Algorithm visualization engine: trace protocol, layouts, themed SVG renderers, and self-tracing data structures
//: private: true for now. This directory is laid out to map 1:1 onto the root of
github.com/mohasinac/dsa, so extracting it later is a git mv plus flipping
It is consumed in-repo through the @dsa/* tsconfig path alias, as SOURCE. That
deliberately means no build step, no transpilePackages entry, no version bump per
change, and — critically — no separate node_modules, so it cannot reintroduce the
dual-React problem that forced appkit's postinstall to delete its own peer deps.
Boundary rules, enforced by eslint rather than discipline:
- no server-only, no firebase/*, no next/*
- theme values are CSS custom property NAMES, never hex — so the package
carries no palette and survives the light-theme swap untouched
Tests use node:test with zero dependencies, following @mohasinac/sievejs.
